{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:32.539
    | text      = I would imagine from everything I can tell from the limited amount of information I found

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:36.539

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = to say that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:54.579
    | text      = It's true.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:55.579
    | text      = Speaking of something else that had a world impact, here's a fable.

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = A little bit of lore for you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:00.619
    | text      = All right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:01.619
    | text      = We have the enemy's playbook.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:05.500
    | text      = The Illuminati in 1776 was trying to copy George Washington, but create a satanic counterfeit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:11.500
    | text      = In Bavaria, Germany, a courier was struck by lightning and it was described in the local
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:17.019
    | text      = police reports and newspaper.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:18.819
    | text      = His body exploded.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:19.819
    | text      = He was hit directly by lightning and there was a 400 plus page document that had been
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:26.460
    | text      = copied by Adam Vysop, the Jesuit priest, the head of the Illuminati, being sent to France
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:35.700
    | text      = on how to overthrow the government and have a French revolution.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:39.579
    | text      = Took them years to do it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:40.579
    | text      = They did it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:41.579
    | text      = And in it, it described how they were going to create an absolute tyranny, how they weren't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:45.500
    | text      = getting rid of one tyranny to make it better, they were creating a total tyranny to end
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:48.819
    | text      = the family, to end humans as we know it, to turn who survives into slaves.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:54.380
    | text      = And because the Germans, or in that province, the Bavarians, the Austrian-Hungarian Empire,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:00.299
    | text      = got those documents, they were unable to take over Germany and Austria and Czechoslovakia
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:11.099
    | text      = and the rest of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:12.099
    | text      = But they were able to take over France.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:13.539
    | text      = But the plan was for all of Europe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:16.339
    | text      = We have the enemy plan.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:18.319
    | text      = We know their operation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:19.319
    | text      = They've been so arrogant.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:20.839
    | text      = So I'm not sure I believe any of this, but I was able to track down some of the basics
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:24.619
    | text      = of this claim to a 2009 book called The Perfectibilists, the 18th century Bavarian order of the Illuminati.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
